description.summary: A hidden-movement deduction game. Robbers hide loot at secret stash points; Cops hunt them through the city before they finish the heist.

content.title: Teams
content.text: Players split into Robbers (1-3 depending on player count) and Cops (the rest). Robbers know each other's positions and plans; Cops coordinate openly.

content.title: Stash points
content.text: Each Robber is secretly assigned 4 stash cells, one in each quadrant of the city grid. They pick one to start at (revealed); the other 3 are hidden targets.

content.title: Cop deployment
content.text: After Robbers reveal their starting cells, each Cop picks a starting square in the central deployment zone.

content.title: Robber moves
content.text: Each Robber moves to one of the 8 adjacent cells. They can also play a Special Movement card: Getaway Car (up to 2 cells in any direction), Backstreet (teleport within a house block), or Speedboat (enter an adjacent water cell). Robbers cannot enter water cells except by playing Speedboat.

content.title: Cop moves
content.text: Each Cop moves up to 2 cells in the 4 orthogonal directions. Cops cannot enter water cells.

content.title: Cop actions
content.text: After moving, each Cop plays either Investigate (probe an adjacent cell; if any Robber visited it this round a snapshot card with that Robber's color is dropped on the cell) or Bust (pick an adjacent cell; if a Robber is currently there, that Robber is busted).

content.title: Stash trail
content.text: Cell labels track which Robbers have visited each cell during the current round. Only Robbers can hover-inspect these labels. When a Robber reaches a new stash, their trail resets and a stash card is placed publicly on that cell.

content.title: Robbers win
content.text: Robbers win if any one Robber successfully drops loot at all 4 stash points.

content.title: Cops win
content.text: Cops win if every Robber is busted, OR if every Robber exhausts their 15-move budget before reaching their next stash.
